name: CFW – Contact Form Chat
author: aa96me

sections.description:
Contact Form WhatsApp is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin to create contact forms that send data directly to your WhatsApp account.
It is designed for users who prefer instant communication over traditional email forms — especially popular in GCC and Arab countries.

Key Features:
* Multiple Forms Support – Create unlimited WhatsApp forms for different pages or purposes.
* Custom Fields – Add dynamic fields (text, phone, email, textarea) with drag & drop ordering and custom placeholders.
* Color Customization – Customize background, text, and button colors to match your theme.
* WhatsApp Integration – One-click message sending directly to your WhatsApp.
* Reports Dashboard – View all submitted messages from the admin panel.
* Date Filtering – Filter messages by date range for easy tracking.
* CSV Export – Export all or filtered messages as CSV.
* Arabic Language Support – Fully supports RTL and Arabic content display.
* Shortcode Ready – Use [contact_form_whatsapp id="FORM_ID"] anywhere in posts, pages, or widgets.

Perfect for businesses, support teams, or stores that rely on WhatsApp for communication.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cfw-contact-form-chat directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WhatsApp Forms in your WordPress dashboard to create and manage forms.
  4. Copy the shortcode and paste it wherever you want the form to appear.
sections.faq:
Does it support Arabic?

Yes! The plugin is fully tested with Arabic and RTL languages.

Can I create multiple forms?

Absolutely, you can create unlimited forms for different pages or sections.

Where can I see the messages?

You can view them in WhatsApp Forms → Reports in your WordPress admin dashboard.

Can I export messages?

Yes, you can export all messages or filter them by date range and download as a CSV file.
